# treecrownr

An R package for calculating tree crown area from diameter measurements.

## Description

This package provides a simple function for calculating the area of circular tree crowns. It also includes an example dataset containing six synthetic tree records.

## Function

The `crown_area()` function calculates crown area in square metres.

```r
library(treecrownr)

crown_area(5)
```

## Example Dataset

```r
data("sample_trees")
head(sample_trees)
```
